brief:
Settlers rammed a vehicle on the Marj Siex road between the villages of al-Mugheir and Abu Fellah, northeast of Ramallah, on Saturday evening, Shehab Wire reported. The incident took place on a route connecting the two Palestinian communities in the northern area of the West Bank.

The circumstances surrounding the collision and whether it resulted in injuries remained unclear. No statement was immediately issued by Palestinian security forces or medical officials regarding the condition of those in the vehicle or the extent of damage sustained in the ramming.
